message.content: {"caption":"Horizontal bar chart comparing evolved reward across eight knowledge types in Opus 4.8.","description":"The chart is titled “Opus 4.8: knowledge type.” Its horizontal axis is “Evolved reward (%)”, with ticks at 0, 25, 50, 75, and 100. Eight bars are ordered from highest to lowest reward: data cleaning procedure (n=7), 85.7%; file format knowledge (n=17), 82.4%; mathematical method (n=28), 80.7%; library API usage (n=33), 79.2%; debugging heuristic (n=8), 70.0%; domain procedure (n=58), 69.2%; tool workflow (n=19), 68.4%; and evaluation protocol (n=3), 66.7%. The bars are blue except for domain procedure, which is gold. A vertical dashed reference labeled “89-task mean” lies at about 69% reward, close to the domain procedure bar. The first four categories are well above this reference; debugging heuristic is just above it, and the last three are around or below it.
